resource_methodology: 资源测试独立使用 557 题，每题执行五次，每种配置共 2,785 次调用。图和总表使用事先固定的 209 题、1,045 次调用；完整资源表另列全部 557 题。每个统计范围都保留成功与失败调用。
七种配置都在 Mac 主机上的 Docker Linux 环境中测量，使用 Linux ARM64 release 二进制和同一资源采集方法。PSS 通过 /proc/PID/smaps_rollup 采集并按进程树求和，CPU 为该进程树的用户态与内核态 CPU 时间之和。250 ms 采集间隔，jobs=1，各配置串行执行。
官方流程先执行 profiler-off 校准，再执行 profiler-on 测量；报告资源值来自后者，校准用于检查采集器影响。P50 是中位数，P95 是第 95 百分位。全部资源变化以 1.1.4 关闭 layout 为基线，表示对应样本统计值的差异。官网 71 MiB 不参与这七组计算。

en.methodLimit: This cohort includes all 372 cases selected from Moli 0.1.1 failures; results apply to this failure subset.
en.search: Search task, driver, or program error
en.metricNote: P50 is the median and P95 the 95th percentile. Duration covers driver execution and grading, excluding browser startup, outer target checks and final evidence writing.
en.methodIntro: Task contracts were frozen in advance. Within each build, the two layout configurations differ only in Moli's --layout flag. The default uses low-cost mock geometry; --layout enables real geometry on demand rather than continuous painting. Optional image and media fetching is a separate control and was unchanged. Functional and resource experiments declare their task populations and attempt counts separately in the configuration tables.
en.analysisIntro: Pair the same task and attempt. Outcome changes and resource costs are interpreted separately.
en.guideIntro: For an agent user, completion comes first, followed by failure waiting time and cost on completed tasks.

resource_methodology: Resources use a separate 557-task experiment with five attempts per task, or 2,785 calls per configuration. The chart and overview table use 1,045 calls on 209 tasks fixed before execution; the detailed resource tables also show all 557 tasks. Each scope retains passing and failing calls.

All seven configurations are measured in Docker Linux on the Mac host, using Linux ARM64 release binaries and the same resource collection method. PSS is read from /proc/PID/smaps_rollup and summed over the process tree; CPU is the tree's user plus system CPU time. Sampling uses a 250 ms interval and jobs=1, with configurations executed serially.

The official procedure runs profiler-off calibration followed by profiler-on measurement. Reported resources come from the latter; calibration checks observer effect. P50 is the median and P95 the 95th percentile. Every resource change uses 1.1.4 with layout off as the baseline and describes the corresponding sample statistic. The website's 71 MiB value is excluded from these seven configurations.
